newsitem.title: USA: Idan unit to sell 25 pct of Elitec Voice.
newsitem.headline: Idan unit to sell 25 pct of Elitec Voice.

text.p: Idan Software Industries I.S.I. Ltd of Tel Aviv said on Monday its 75-percent owned subsidiary Elitec Industries 77 Ltd will exercise its put option to sell 25 percent of Elitec Voice Systems (1993) Ltd to Tevel Ltd.
Tevel will pay the equivalent of US $716,000 in a deal to be concluded by March 30.
Elitec has informed Tevel it will exercise its put option to sell its remaining 25 percent interest in Elitec Voice to Tevel in August 1997, when the option vests.
Idan provides telecommunications services and products, mostly in Israel.
